steps.code:
# Search for each old song to find its song_id
old_song_ids = []
for song in old_songs:
    query = f"{song['title']} {song['artists']}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'], page_limit=20)
    # Find the exact match
    found = None
    for r in results:
        # Check title match (case-insensitive)
        if r['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            # Check if all artists match
            artist_names = [a['name'].lower() for a in r['artists']]
            song_artists = [a.strip().lower() for a in song['artists'].split(',')]
            if all(any(sa in an for an in artist_names) for sa in song_artists) or all(any(an in sa for an in artist_names) for sa in song_artists):
                found = r
                break
    if found:
        old_song_ids.append(found['song_id'])
        print(f"Found: {found['title']} (ID: {found['song_id']})")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song['title']} by {song['artists']}")

print(f"\nTotal old song IDs found: {len(old_song_ids)}")
